oracle.nature: reference-assisted source-only diagnostic; not automatic retrieval

main.selection: No model score based tuning; candidate selected from training character-role imbalance and audit

retrieval.method: BM25 role budget; user vs non-user each 10 blocks/6000 characters; global BM25 display order; no unused quota transfer
retrieval.not_selected_reason: neighborhood cannot recover entire absent sessions and may multiply long advice; no training evidence justifies added mechanism

review.primary: hidden condition labels; external AI; exact deployment unknown
review.independent_scope: all abstention, clothing and bird responses; all answers in any qid/round having discordant primary labels in four planned comparisons; all oracle responses for quality
review.resolution: Preserve primary and audit; conflicting labels become uncertain in separate conservative derived statistics. No relabeling loops.

dinner_quality.note: Two ingredient groups: basil OR mint, and cherry tomatoes; combined yes requires both. Separate from correctness rubric.

scope: fixed development only; no training rules, no test contents, no new model
budget_note: 132 answers +1 warmup; failed requests count. No automatic retries; reserve not a target.
